# Mark decisions — Haidakhan / Anandamayi Ma
Date: 2026-08-20

## Haidakhan
- Haidakhan Babaji and Mahavatar Babaji MUST NOT be silently merged as historical identity.
- Yogananda/SRF/YSS tradition and Haidakhan-followers use different identity claims; Haidakhan followers may identify Haidakhan Babaji as Mahavatar Babaji, while this is not treated as established identity in the Yogananda lineage layer.
- Mark nevertheless wants Haidakhan as an A destination because Haidakhan Babaji personally speaks to him.
- Only the main Haidakhan site is required; additional Haidakhan lineage sites are C unless they later add exceptional value.
- Haidakhan occurs near the beginning of Mark's journey; leave experiential space because the visit may influence later choices.

## Anandamayi Ma
- Mark wants approximately THREE truly important Anandamayi Ma destinations total, not an exhaustive house-by-house pilgrimage.
- Kankhal = A and occupies one of those core slots because of Ma's Mahasamadhi and active veneration.
- Vrindavan Ashram = currently A; Ma's own activity/presence there has been established.
- For Varanasi, first bundle ALL Anandamayi findings by physical parent site / walking proximity before asking for choices.
- Explicitly identify the genuine MAGNET sites: active veneration, Ma's own repeated/important presence, preserved room/shrine/samadhi or other meaningful continuity, and practical visitability.
- Give Mark an editorial recommendation for which Varanasi Anandamayi site(s) deserve A when only ~3 total Anandamayi sites are wanted.
- Microplaces inside one compound are one decision number and are retained underneath as final-trip details, not separate ABC decisions.
